evidence: World 3.1.3 owned Boundary 1.5.0 identity in build.zig.zon, production_package_identity, dependency checkers, external-consumer proof, tests, and docs.

After moving every live surface to World 3.1.4 and exact Boundary f8d7ace/v1.6.0, zig build check --summary all completed 95 of 95 steps and 41 of 41 tests, including Application ABI, external-consumer, native/WASM parity, and negative gates.
record.application: For future dependency-identity changes in World, search and update every identity-bearing build, manifest, checker, test, and documentation surface before claiming compatibility; require the full World check to prove that runtime and ABI behavior remain unchanged.
